notes.title: Steam "DesperaDrops" Available Now!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ttZtvSBGZb4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]D3P Otome and RED Entertainment have teamed up again to present[/h3]

Embark on a thrilling adventure in DesperaDrops, the highly anticipated romantic visual novel on Steam. Mika Amamine is wrongly accused of murder and needs to evade both the police and a group of mysterious assailants along with six other fugitives.

To celebrate the release of "DesperaDrops" on Steam, we are holding an opening sale where you can purchase the game at a [b]20% discount[/b] until June 10th! Don't miss this opportunity to get the game at a discounted price!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291080/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33518623/27cdf771bf64195cdac6f2ab15ea4694a9c5c0fb.png[/img]

What's more, D3P Otome and Red Entertainment have teamed up to bring you a special bundle featuring the Reviews: Overwhelmingly Positive "Nightshade" and the latest release "DesperaDrops"! Enjoy the exquisite story woven by unique characters from two different works.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52981/
